meta.title: WARC outreach library

corporate_background.note: Akros Lab is corporate background; WARC is the WhatsApp receptionist product. Outreach affiliation must name Akros Lab (WARC).

positioning.working: Help clinics turn WhatsApp enquiries they already receive into a clear booking path.
positioning.not: Patient acquisition / lead generation / guaranteed bookings or revenue

hormozi_principles.demonstrable_process: 5-minute walkthrough on demo flow (nothing to install to see it)
hormozi_principles.reduced_setup_effort: Show before install; team stays in control of confirmation
forbidden: unverified D2 metrics in public copy

d2_coded_site_metrics.rule: Omit from public outreach copy until dated evidence and permission exist

d2_founder_reported_10k.rule: Never publish in outreach or list validation

meta.list_nature_note: Historical openings remain in prospects[] with prospect_category=historical. Current = verified UK opens/new locations with event dates in Sep–Nov 2026 (publication date ≤ as_of; no future-dated sources). Upcoming = announced without confirmed open as of as_of. Templates not modified in this revision.

tracker_xlsx.rule: Do not reuse contacts until inspected and deduped

template_rendering.ui_default: Show public body only. Block send when channel_eligibility fails or action_type is workflow without an optional message body.
blocked_when: action_type is workflow and no optional public message selected
whatsapp_use_verified is false and template assumes WhatsApp without a question hedge — prefer ig_en_c

pieces.name: Online booking
pieces.note: Do not promise named PMS until confirmed

options.when: Default for first outreach where a lawful basis exists
After documented opt-in, content follow, or inbound request
Only for partners who already know the lab

corporate_email.note: Clinic Ltd status alone does not prove an Instagram account is a corporate subscriber.

instagram_dm.note: Clinic Ltd status alone does not prove an Instagram account is a corporate subscriber.

personalisation_fields.description: Recipient display name if known and lawful to use
Clinic or practice name from evidence
Plain dated open from evidence, e.g. May 2026 — no relative just/new phrasing
One factual clause from evidence (location or source hook)
Short source label for the opening fact
Founder or authorised sender given name
Sender phone if approved for signature
Pass/fail from consent_gate for email vs IG
enquiry_admin_potential | expansion_ops | unknown — never invent WhatsApp use
Spain/inbound only: the recipient's actual prior request phrasing, e.g. 'pedir información sobre WARC'. Never an opening date or clinic launch detail.

triggers.description: Dated public opening or expansion coverage exists
Recipient requested info or prior opt-in on file
Public or confirmed evidence clinic uses WhatsApp for patients — do not assume
New site inside an existing group — process standardisation angle only
Public ICB/press demand for NHS registration — classify enquiry_admin_potential only, not acquisition

channel_eligibility.note: PECR electronic-mail rules for IG DM; UK GDPR interest alone is not an alternative PECR gate.

instagram_openings_en.body: Hi {{Name}} — I'm {{Sender}} with Akros Lab (WARC). Congrats on {{Clinic}} opening in {{OpeningMonthYear}}. We help clinics map patient WhatsApp enquiries into a clear booking path (not patient-acquisition ads). If WhatsApp is a channel you already use for patients and this is useful, OK if I send three short lines — or would email be better?
internal_notes: Send only if IG channel eligibility passes (explicit consent OR independently confirmed corporate subscriber).
Do not send if WhatsApp patient use is unverified and the question would assume it — prefer ig_en_c.
Silence is not consent.

channel_eligibility.note: PECR electronic-mail rules for IG DM; UK GDPR interest alone is not an alternative PECR gate.

instagram_openings_en.body: Hi {{Name}}, I'm {{Sender}} at Akros Lab (product: WARC). {{Clinic}} opened {{OpeningMonthYear}} per {{Source}}. If you already take patient messages on WhatsApp, do you have a set hand-off to a booking link, or is every reply still fully manual? I can share how we set that up — only if useful.
internal_notes: Conditional clause already hedges WhatsApp use; still do not send if product is WhatsApp-only and you have zero signal they use it — use ig_en_c.
Send only if IG eligibility passes.
Silence is not consent.

channel_eligibility.note: PECR electronic-mail rules for IG DM; UK GDPR interest alone is not an alternative PECR gate.

instagram_openings_en.body: {{Name}}, I'm {{Sender}} with Akros Lab (WARC). Saw {{Clinic}} open {{OpeningMonthYear}}. WARC is a WhatsApp receptionist for clinics that already use WhatsApp for patients — mapping enquiries to a booking link, not acquiring patients. Do you use WhatsApp for patient enquiries today? If yes and useful, I can send a one-pager when you ask.
internal_notes: Preferred opener when WhatsApp use is unverified — asks rather than assumes.
Send only if IG eligibility passes.
Silence is not consent.

channel_eligibility.note: LSSI: SL/corporate status does not unlock cold sends. Warm intro alone is not consent.

instagram_or_email_es_inbound_only.body: Hola {{Name}}, soy {{Sender}} de Akros Lab (WARC). Gracias por {{RequestContext}}. WARC ayuda a clínicas a convertir consultas de WhatsApp que ya reciben en una vía clara de reserva (no es captación de pacientes). ¿Te envío tres líneas o prefieres una llamada de 5 minutos?
internal_notes: RequestContext must be the actual prior request (e.g. pedir información sobre WARC), never OpeningDetail or opening date.
Cold Spanish electronic marketing out of scope.
Offer opt-out on email: reply baja.

follow_ups.workflow_instruction: Send exactly one opening message template (ig_en_a/b/c or eligible email). Include Akros Lab (WARC) affiliation. No carousel dump. No second channel yet.
internal_notes: Not a send body — orchestrator step only.
Channel eligibility must already pass for the chosen template.

follow_ups.body: Hi {{Name}} — {{Sender}} again from Akros Lab (WARC). Happy to close the loop: want the three lines, or shall I leave it? Reply stop if you prefer no further messages.
internal_notes: Only if no opt-out and lawful basis / eligibility still valid.
No response is not consent; do not escalate pressure.
On email keep explicit opt-out; on IG use stop language appropriate to the thread.

follow_ups.body: Last note from me — {{Sender}} at Akros Lab (WARC). Walkthrough is at warc.akroslab.com if useful; otherwise I'll stop. Reply stop to opt out.
internal_notes: Record opt-out promptly.
Do not keep monthly circling without consent.
Only if eligibility still valid and no prior opt-out.

follow_ups.workflow_instruction: When they engage: move to email or call for the 5-minute walkthrough. Marketing may share verified carousels only after engagement. No guaranteed-bookings copy. Confirm booking/SMS integrations before any end-to-end automation promise.

optional_ack_message.body: Thanks {{Name}} — {{Sender}} at Akros Lab (WARC). I can do a free 5-minute walkthrough (demo flow, nothing to install to see it). Prefer a call or email? Reply stop anytime to opt out.
internal_notes: Integrations beyond WhatsApp reply + booking-link hand-off are unconfirmed — keep that caveat internal; do not put in public body unless product confirms.
Use only after clear engagement.
Not a cold send body — orchestrator step; optional_ack_message is the public-ready short ack if needed.

channel_eligibility.note: Operator verification and mailbox/subscriber verification are separate. Named individuals still need UK GDPR assessment.

body_paragraphs: I'm {{Sender}} at Akros Lab (WARC). Congrats on {{Clinic}} opening in {{OpeningMonthYear}} ({{Source}}). WARC is a WhatsApp receptionist that helps answer clinic enquiries and send your booking link — it is not a patient-acquisition service.
If useful, I can show a free 5-minute walkthrough on a demo flow (nothing to install to see it). To opt out of further email from me, reply stop.
internal_notes: Integrations beyond WhatsApp reply + booking-link hand-off should be confirmed before any automation promise — keep internal until product confirms.
Send only when operator and corporate mailbox/subscriber are both verified; identity + opt-out required.
UK GDPR still applies when using named individual personal data.

removed.reason: Commercial consent solicitation is not safe merely labelled permission; removed from pack

measurement.note: Small historical n cannot cleanly target 20 touches; replenish list or use calendar window.

metrics.definition: Outbound DM/email only after operator + channel eligibility recorded
Explicit yes to more info or walkthrough; silence ≠ yes
Calendar invite or agreed slot created
Verified WhatsApp (or stated equivalent) for patients + booking-link interest; NHS high-demand ≠ acquisition
